data.summary: In the single week before the exam, the student will conduct an intensive, comprehensive review of every AP Chemistry unit, focusing on key concepts and timed practice to solidify understanding and test readiness.

weeks.focus: Full‑content review and timed practice across all units
tasks: Review each topic sheet for 30 seconds, noting any gaps.
Do 2‑question free‑response sets for each unit (total 18 questions), marking against the scoring guide.
Complete a full‑length AP Chemistry practice exam under timed conditions (3 hours).
Grade the practice exam, record missed points, and create a quick‑review sheet for each error.
Watch a 1‑hour summary video covering common AP‑style tricks and calculator shortcuts.
Spend 30 minutes revisiting the weakest‑appearing topics from the practice exam.
Do 5 mixed‑topic multiple‑choice drills (20 questions) focusing on speed.
Review key equations and constants on flashcards for 15 minutes.
Write a one‑page outline summarizing each unit’s core concepts.
Relax with a 10‑minute breathing exercise to reduce test anxiety.

data.final_week_advice: Enter the exam confident: trust your quick‑review sheets, manage time wisely, and double‑check units and significant figures on every free‑response answer.
